tasks.title: Implement `agentshield wrap` core command
tasks.description: Create the main `wrap` subcommand that orchestrates proxy startup, env var injection, child process execution, and graceful shutdown per R1 requirements
tasks.details: Add `wrap` clap subcommand. Implement flow: check/create agentshield.toml → spawn proxy tokio task → set HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY env vars → spawn child process with std::process::Command.env() → wait for child or signal → shutdown proxy and exit with child code. Use tokio::spawn for proxy in same process. Handle --mitm flag by calling existing CA logic.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests: config creation, child spawn/exit code propagation, proxy startup/shutdown. Integration test: `wrap -- echo hello` completes with exit code 0 and proxy logs show startup.

tasks.title: Implement agent auto-detection and policy templates for wrap
tasks.description: Add command pattern matching for agent detection (claude, openclaw, aider, codex) and automatic policy template application per R1-3 table
tasks.details: Create AgentDetector struct with match patterns for known agents → map to template names. On wrap, if no --template, auto-detect and call policy template apply logic. Extend existing template system to include new templates: aider-default, codex-default. Store mapping in HashMap<&str, &str>.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for each pattern: `claude`→`claude-code-default`, `npx openclaw`→`openclaw-default`, unknown→`strict`. Verify generated TOML contains correct allowlist domains.

tasks.title: Implement `agentshield quickstart` interactive setup
tasks.description: Create guided interactive setup wizard that generates config, handles CA setup, and configures notifications per R2 requirements
tasks.details: Use dialoguer crate for interactive prompts. Steps: agent selection menu → MITM yes/no → CA init if mitm → notification channel selection → save to agentshield.toml. Provide defaults for all prompts. Show final `wrap` command. Handle existing config overwrite prompt.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test with mocked stdin: simulate Claude+MITM+Slack flow → verify generated TOML content and CA cert creation. Test default path (Enter only).

tasks.title: Implement Slack webhook notifications
tasks.description: Add Slack Incoming Webhook support to existing Notifier trait for one-way notifications per R3-1
tasks.details: Create SlackNotifier struct implementing Notifier trait. Parse [notification.slack] TOML section. Format Block Kit JSON payloads for deny/allow/ask events. Use reqwest::Client for POST to webhook_url. Support optional channel override. Graceful error handling (don't block proxy).
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests: format_slack_message() for each NotificationEvent type. Mock reqwest test: verify 200 response. Error case: network failure doesn't panic.

tasks.title: Implement Slack interactive ASK responder (Socket Mode)
tasks.description: Extend Slack support with Socket Mode for bidirectional ASK approval/deny buttons per R3-2
tasks.details: Create SlackAskResponder implementing AskResponder trait. Parse app_token, bot_token from TOML. Use tokio-tungstenite for WebSocket connection to wss://wss-primary.slack.com. Handle events.api.interaction.callback for button clicks. Map Allow/Deny → AskResponse. Auto-reconnect on disconnect.
tasks.testStrategy: Mock WebSocket server test: send ASK → receive button interaction → verify AskBroadcaster receives correct response. Test reconnection logic.

tasks.title: Add new policy templates (aider, codex, cursor, development-general, minimal-llm)
tasks.description: Create 5 new policy templates per R6-1 table with specific allow domains for broader agent support
tasks.details: Add templates/ directory with TOML files matching exact domain allowlists from PRD table. Ensure valid AppConfig parsing. Update auto-detection to map new agents. Validate all templates pass `agentshield validate`.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests: each template TOML parses to valid AppConfig without errors. Policy evaluation test: known allowed domains pass, others correctly denied.

tasks.title: Implement graceful shutdown and signal handling
tasks.description: Add proper SIGTERM/Ctrl+C handling with connection draining and child process cleanup for wrap mode per R10
tasks.details: Use tokio::signal::ctrl_c() + signal-hook for SIGTERM. Set 5s drain timeout for active connections. In wrap mode: send SIGTERM to child → wait 10s → SIGKILL. Flush logs and send shutdown notification. Close DB connections cleanly.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test: start wrap proxy + child → send SIGTERM → verify child receives signal, proxy drains connections, exit code preserved.

tasks.title: Create E2E integration tests for core proxy pipeline
tasks.description: Add comprehensive E2E tests covering allow/deny, MITM DLP, rate limiting, ASK, hot-reload, and wrap per R7
tasks.details: Create tests/e2e/ binary. Each test: spawn proxy on random port → start local TCP mock server → reqwest client with proxy → assert response codes. Cover all R7-1 scenarios. Use #[tokio::test]. Add to CI with cargo test --test e2e.
tasks.testStrategy: Run all E2E tests locally and in CI. Verify 100% pass rate. Test failure logs include proxy output.

tasks.title: Setup GitHub Actions for multi-platform binary releases
tasks.description: Configure CI to build and upload binaries for 4 platforms on tag push per R5-1
tasks.details: Create .github/workflows/release.yml. Use rust-action with matrix: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, x86_64-apple-darwin, aarch64-apple-darwin. Strip binaries, create tar.gz/zip, upload to GitHub Release. Trigger on tags v*.*.*.
tasks.testStrategy: Manual test: create v1.0.0-rc1 tag → verify 4 binaries appear in release assets. Test each binary extracts and runs `agentshield --version`.

tasks.title: Create install.sh one-liner and Homebrew formula
tasks.description: Implement curl|sh installer and Homebrew tap for zero-friction installation per R5-2/5-3
tasks.details: install.sh: detect OS/arch → download latest release asset → install to /usr/local/bin or ~/.local/bin → verify execution. Create homebrew-tap repo with agentshield.rb formula using GitHub release URL. Add shellcheck CI.
tasks.testStrategy: Test install.sh on Ubuntu, macOS Intel/ARM: curl|sh → verify binary in PATH and `agentshield --version` works.

tasks.title: Implement Discord webhook and interactive ASK support
tasks.description: Add Discord notifications and button-based ASK responder per R4 requirements
tasks.details: Create DiscordNotifier (webhook embeds) and DiscordAskResponder (Gateway WS). Use reqwest for REST, tokio-tungstenite for wss://gateway.discord.gg. Parse bot_token, channel_id from TOML. Implement interaction handling for Allow/Deny buttons.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for embed formatting. Mock Discord gateway test: ASK → button click → response propagation.

tasks.title: Implement community template loading and CLI commands
tasks.description: Add `agentshield policy template --list` and custom template loading from ~/.agentshield/templates/ per R6-2
tasks.details: Create TemplateManager: scan ~/.agentshield/templates/*.toml → validate → list/apply. Add clap subcommands. Ensure hot-reload watches template dir changes.
tasks.testStrategy: Test: create custom template → list shows it → apply loads correctly → policy evaluation uses new rules.

tasks.title: Update README, create CONTRIBUTING.md, CHANGELOG.md, and issue templates
tasks.description: Complete documentation for v1.0 community release per R9 requirements
tasks.details: Rewrite README with 30s demo GIF embed, Why AgentShield section, 3-line Quick Start, feature matrix. Create CONTRIBUTING.md (setup, PR rules), CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog format), GitHub issue templates (bug, feature, template).
tasks.testStrategy: Manual review: verify all sections present, links work, GIF displays correctly.
